text: Under the purview of the Dean of Students, the Office of Community Standards and Conduct investigates allegations of academic dishonesty. As a member of the UT Dallas community, you may be the first one to notice a student exhibiting distress, disruptive behavior or academic dishonesty.

The student does not need to be violating any University rules or regulations for you to be concerned. Please contact the Office of Community Standards and Conduct and we can begin a dialogue with the student and provide referrals.
Allegations of student conduct violations are to be referred to the Dean of Students.

Behavior Assessment and Intervention Team. The Behavior Assessment and Intervention Team (BAIT) reviews behavioral incidents and ensures a systematic response to students whose behavior may be disruptive or harmful to themselves or the UT Dallas community, and assists in promoting the health, safety and welfare of students and other members of the UT Dallas community.
